comments.1: Listen for what Minokichi sees when he wakes up.
comments.2: Minokichi was allowed to live, but he was warned to keep what he saw a secret. Will he keep that secret as his life changes?
comments.3: Minokichi has kept his secret for years. Now he tells Yuki he once saw a woman who looked like her. What does Yuki want to know?

preview.text: This is a Japanese winter tale about Minokichi, a young woodcutter, and a mysterious woman in white. As the story moves from a snowbound hut to a family home, listen for how its unsettling beginning connects with what comes later.
